entries.title: Android and iPhone/iOS global launch requirement
entries.decision: Global completion requires Web + Android + iPhone/iOS. Existing mobile state is PWA/checklist readiness only, not native store-ready release. Adopt one shared web core with a secure native mobile layer, separate mobile CI, signing isolation, deep links, push, secure storage, RTL/LTR, real-device tests, store legal assets and owner-gated production environments.
